basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | research associate (ra) - research: Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree or having 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech with at least one research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal. Desired Experience: Candidate with interdisciplinary research experience in designing and developing food processing machinery, and its validation with field trials. (Essential Qualification for RA includes Ph.D. or equivalent degree in Agricultural Engineering/Food Engineering/Mechanical Engineering/Instrumentation or having 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after ME/M.Tech in Agricultural Engineering/Food Engineering/Mechanical Engineering/Instrumentation with at least one research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal).

salary_details.research associate (ra) - research: Rs. 67000 per month for Ph.D. holders and Rs. 61000 per month for M. Tech. holders (Consolidated compensation upto 67000 depending on qualification and experience)

how_to_apply: Visit the official IIT Kharagpur recruitment portal or access the online application link.
Review the detailed notification for advertisement number IIT/SRIC/R/HPT_SALARY/2026/107.
Deposit any applicable application fee through RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking using the provided bank account details and note the transaction UTR number or transaction ID.
Fill out the online application form with your personal, educational, and experience details, including transaction reference numbers.
Submit the online application form on or before 24 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this notification?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT Kharagpur) under the Department of Agricultural and Food Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under IIT Kharagpur Research Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the Research Associate (RA) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Kharagpur Research Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 24 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree or 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech with at least one SCI journal research paper.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IIT Kharagpur Research Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the last date of the advertisement, with relaxations as per sponsor agency rules.
